title: F7 documentation and integration verification

conformance.reason: Task 20.3 is documentation reconciliation and integration verification of behaviour already implemented and reviewed in 20.1/20.2. It adds no new Jellyfin 12 platform assumption, provider contract, or first-time ADR-against-host implementability question; it records the resolution of F7, adds ADR amendment notes without rewriting accepted text, corrects architecture wording, and adds one deterministic reconciler-resume regression test over the existing recovery gate.

notes: Runtime figures are the authoritative OpenCode server values for each child session (read directly from the running server because the collect-session-usage.sh CLI cannot talk to this server instance). implementation-reviewer and test-quality-reviewer reported cost_usd 0 (the provider's runtime value), recorded as-is. No rework: the implementation-reviewer approved attempt 1 with no open findings; the test-quality-reviewer returned PASS_WITH_FINDINGS with INFORMATIONAL findings only. TQR-20.2-01 was closed by the new ArtworkReconcilerTests.RestorationWithAnAbsentBaselineIsResumedAsARemoval case.
